name: @veren/commander-build
description: Use when you want the veren CLI's `build` command as a standard Cordis plugin module (name/inject/Config/apply): it injects the command registry, the Discovery service and ctx.fs, classifies each unit (frontend plugin bundle, backend plugin tsc-style build, cargo build for Cargo.toml units) and runs the per-kind command in the unit directory; skip it when you build units with your own tooling.
